lines.zh: 圆圆的，像只长了叶子的球。
lines.en: Round as a ball with leaves on top.

lines.zh: 我跟着其他小的，排成一排。
lines.en: I follow the other small ones in a line.
Two leaves on top of my head.
I waddle to the grass edge and look.

lines.zh: 脚太小，走起来一颠一颠。
lines.en: My feet are tiny. I bob when I walk.

lines.zh: 我绕着一块苔石走了半圈。
lines.en: I walk half a circle around a mossy stone.
I sit and wait for orders.
The leaves sway, and I sway with them.

lines.zh: 我趴在草里，吐了个小泡泡。
lines.en: I lie in the grass and blow a little bubble.

lines.zh: 我还很小，什么都做不好。
lines.en: I'm small. I'm not good at much.

lines.zh: 等我长大，就能保护你了。
lines.en: When I grow up, I can protect you.
I look up at my master.

lines.zh: 我在数身边有几个同伴。
lines.en: I count my companions around me.

lines.zh: 我打了个小嗝，冒了个泡。
lines.en: I hiccup and a bubble pops out.
You lower your head so I can see.
You're so tall. I'm looking up.

lines.zh: 你身上有饲料的味道，是你吗？
lines.en: You smell of feed. Is it you?
If someone comes near, I'll call.

lines.zh: 我会一直看着你的方向。

lines.en: You moved off. Where did you go?

lines.zh: 我被撞得滚出去，撞到树干。
lines.en: I am knocked rolling until I hit a trunk.
I puff my cheeks. It hurts.

lines.zh: 我摔进草丛，又爬起来找你。
lines.en: I tumble into the grass and get up to find you.

lines.zh: 腿有点软，我撑着站起来。
lines.en: My legs are weak; I push myself up.

lines.zh: 我还小，这一下挨得有点重。
lines.en: I am still small; that hit was rather heavy.
I roll over there and nearly fall.
I eat it bit by bit.

lines.zh: 放在地上，我自己慢慢吃。
lines.en: Put it on the ground; I will eat in my own time.

lines.zh: 你把饲料放低些，我够得着。
lines.en: Lower the feed a bit so I can reach it.

lines.zh: 我小口小口啃，饲料还没吃完。
lines.en: I nibble slowly; the feed is not finished.
After eating I'll sit a while.
Eat too much and I get rounder.

lines.zh: 我一打滚，叶子粘了满身。
lines.en: I roll once, and leaves stick all over me.
Against your leg. That's fine too.
Your feet are big. You go ahead.
You're a baby stage too, aren't you.

lines.zh: 比高兽的芽，跟着我别走散。
lines.en: Pyocomon's sprout: follow me, do not stray.
A flower bud crowns my head.
I roll it with my head.
I push it to my master.
Pushed it to you. It's mine.
I bite it. Not very good.
I bury it in the grass.
I puff my cheeks to blow bubbles.

lines.zh: 有东西靠近，我先站起来。
lines.en: Something approaches; I stand up first.

lines.zh: 我朝那个方向叫了一声。
lines.en: I call out toward that direction.
I called out. It hasn't backed off.
It won't back off. Then I blow bubbles.

lines.zh: 我面朝那个影子，不挪开。
lines.en: I face that shadow and will not look away.
It goes left. I turn slowly.
I'm too short to see well.

lines.zh: 我朝它的方向轻轻跳了一下。
lines.en: I give a small hop toward it.
I go behind my master's leg.

lines.zh: 风把它的气味送到我这边。
lines.en: The wind brings its scent to me.

lines.zh: 我头上这朵花，一开一合在数。
lines.en: The flower on my head opens and shuts, counting.

lines.zh: 我鼓起腮，吐出一串泡泡。
lines.en: I puff my cheeks and blow a string of bubbles.

lines.zh: 我鼓起身体，直直撞过去。
lines.en: I puff myself up and charge straight in.

lines.zh: 泡泡一碰就炸，我也弹开。
lines.en: The bubble bursts, and I bounce away too.
The flower on my head turns.

lines.zh: 我张开身体，挡在主人前头。
lines.en: I spread myself out in front of my master.
If there's a fight, hit me first.
Small, but I don't step back.

lines.zh: 我把泡吐在它眼睛前面。
lines.en: I blow a bubble right in front of its eyes.
It blinked a few times and stepped back.
I pop up out of the grass.
Plenty of grass here. Just right.

lines.zh: 我从草里探出圆脑袋，四处看。
lines.en: I poke my round head from the grass and look around.
There's a path to the wood.
I roll a few steps that way.
Fire neared and my leaves curled.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下去，停不住。
lines.en: I rolled down the slope and couldn't stop.

lines.zh: 水里我浮着，可也呛到了。
lines.en: I float in water, but I swallowed some.
The blast spun me round and round.

lines.zh: 那光一闪，我的泡泡都没了。
lines.en: A flash and my bubbles were gone.

lines.zh: 饿久了，我连滚都滚不动。
雷声一响，我全身的毛都竖了。
lines.en: At the thunderclap, all my fur stands up.
